label: Chapter 43
english: It is necessary to be aware of the differences between demons and to interpret their different occasions: this we shall know from the tempting thoughts, and the tempting thoughts from the objects they depict; thus knowing which demons are less frequent and heavier, which are more frequent and lighter, and which leap suddenly and snatch the nous off to blasphemy.

These things it is necessary to know, so that when tempting thoughts begin to move their own particular matter, and before we are driven too far from our proper state, we may speak out to them and indicate which one is present. For thus we shall with God’s help readily make progress, amazing them and forcing them to flee from us.
